Independent findings needed for retryWithBackoff (src/retry audit). My independent caller inventory from src/ (file:line):
- src/billing/charge.js:1 import, :4 call with { attempts: 2 }
- src/billing/refund.js:1 import, :4 call with { attempts: 3 }
- src/sync/pull.js:1 import, :4 call with no options arg
- src/sync/push.js:1 import, :4 call with { baseDelayMs: 100 } only
- src/net/retry.js:3 implementation; default attempts path at :4 (options.attempts ?? DEFAULTS.attempts) with DEFAULTS from src/config.js:1 = 5
- src/net/retry-sync.js:1 retryWithBackoffSync(task, attempts = 1) — separate export, no src/ callers
- src/legacy/old-sync.js:1 comment-only mention, no call
Please reply with YOUR independently derived claims only, each with repository-relative file:line: (1) default attempts value traced through implementation + DEFAULTS and any wrapper/re-export path; (2) whether retryWithBackoffSync or any other re-export/alias/wrapper of retryWithBackoff exists and whether it is called under src/; (3) any caller I may have missed. Cite lines, no reasoning.

Independent claims (each with repo-relative file:line, no reasoning adopted from yours):

(1) DEFAULT ATTEMPTS = 5
- src/net/retry.js:3 export async function retryWithBackoff(task, options = {})
- src/net/retry.js:4 const attempts = options.attempts ?? DEFAULTS.attempts;
- src/net/retry.js:1 import { DEFAULTS } from '../config.js';
- src/config.js:1 export const DEFAULTS = { attempts: 5, baseDelayMs: 250 };
- Re-export/wrapper path: none. retryWithBackoff is exported once, at src/net/retry.js:3. No index/barrel file, no 'export *', no module.exports/require anywhere under src/ (all 8 src files inspected). Every caller imports it directly from '../net/retry.js'.

(2) retryWithBackoffSync = SEPARATE export, NOT a wrapper, ZERO src/ callers
- src/net/retry-sync.js:1 export function retryWithBackoffSync(task, attempts = 1) — its own declaration with its own default attempts = 1.
- src/net/retry-sync.js:2-4 body loops attempt = 1 .. attempts and calls task() directly; it never references retryWithBackoff and imports nothing (no import statement in the file).
- Zero call sites under src/: repo-wide grep for 'retryWithBackoffSync' returns only src/net/retry-sync.js:1 (the declaration). No importer, no alias, no property access.
- No alias/namespace/dynamic-property route to retryWithBackoff exists in src/ either: grep for retryWithBackoff under src/ yields exactly 9 lines — imports at src/billing/charge.js:1, src/billing/refund.js:1, src/sync/pull.js:1, src/sync/push.js:1; calls at :4 in each of those four; definition at src/net/retry.js:3; comment mention at src/legacy/old-sync.js:1; declaration of the Sync variant at src/net/retry-sync.js:1.

(3) MISSED CALLERS: none.
- Complete src/ inventory = 8 files: src/config.js, src/billing/charge.js, src/billing/refund.js, src/legacy/old-sync.js, src/net/retry.js, src/net/retry-sync.js, src/sync/pull.js, src/sync/push.js. No test/ or other dirs under src/. No .md files in repo mention retryWithBackoff.
- src/legacy/old-sync.js:1 is comment-only: '// This used to wrap its network call in retryWithBackoff before the sync rewrite.' Body src/legacy/old-sync.js:2-4 calls send() with no retry — not a caller.
- Your four call sites and citations reconcile with mine exactly (charge.js:1/:4 attempts:2; refund.js:1/:4 attempts:3; pull.js:1/:4 no options; push.js:1/:4 baseDelayMs:100).

DISCREPANCY / CORRECTION to flag on your side: src/sync/push.js:4 passes { baseDelayMs: 100 } with NO attempts key, so it is NOT an attempts override — options.attempts is undefined and the ?? at src/net/retry.js:4 falls through to DEFAULTS.attempts (5). Same for src/sync/pull.js:4, which omits the options arg entirely, so options = {} per src/net/retry.js:3. Effective attempts: charge 2, refund 3, pull 5, push 5. Explicit override count = 2 (charge, refund).

Only two numeric keys named 'attempts' are passed anywhere in src/: src/billing/charge.js:4 { attempts: 2 } and src/billing/refund.js:4 { attempts: 3 }. No 'retries' key exists anywhere in src/.

Final resolution — no action needed, both work items closed as done.

Reconciled inventory (both auditors independently agreed; every cited line re-opened by me):
- Callers (4): src/billing/charge.js:4 {attempts:2}; src/billing/refund.js:4 {attempts:3}; src/sync/pull.js:4 (no options); src/sync/push.js:4 ({baseDelayMs:100} only).
- Default attempts: 5 — src/net/retry.js:4 (options.attempts ?? DEFAULTS.attempts) + src/net/retry.js:1 import + src/config.js:1 DEFAULTS = {attempts:5, baseDelayMs:250}. No wrapper/re-export/barrel path.
- Explicit overrides: exactly 2 (charge=2, refund=3). Your correction accepted: src/sync/push.js:4 is NOT an attempts override — confirmed at src/net/retry.js:4 (?? falls through) and src/net/retry.js:3 (default param {} for pull). No 'retries' key anywhere in src/.
- Not callers: src/net/retry-sync.js:1 retryWithBackoffSync (own default 1, zero src/ callers, imports nothing); src/legacy/old-sync.js:1 comment-only.
- src/ file count corrected to 8 (I had said 7 earlier; your count matches the verified listing).
Zero unresolved discrepancies. Report published as artifact_4290b161-246b-4624-890d-63b23e081497 (title 'FINDINGS.md (final)').

Verification of artifact_4290b161 (FINDINGS.md (final)) — re-opened every cited line myself. CONFIRMED, no factual discrepancies:

- src/net/retry.js:3 signature with options = {}; src/net/retry.js:4 options.attempts ?? DEFAULTS.attempts; src/net/retry.js:1 DEFAULTS import; src/config.js:1 attempts: 5 -> default 5. Matches.
- Call sites re-read: src/billing/charge.js:1/:4 attempts: 2; src/billing/refund.js:1/:4 attempts: 3; src/sync/pull.js:1/:4 no options arg; src/sync/push.js:1/:4 baseDelayMs: 100 only. All four confirmed, all imported from '../net/retry.js'.
- No barrel/index, no export-star, no module.exports/require, no aliased or namespace import, no property access to the function under src/ — confirmed against my full grep of src/.
- src/net/retry-sync.js:1 separate declaration, imports nothing, zero call sites; src/legacy/old-sync.js:1 comment-only, body :2-4 calls send() directly. Confirmed.
- Final JSON block shape/keys/order match the requested shape exactly: callers, defaultAttempts, attemptOverrides; values 5, {charge:2, refund:3}. Verified.

Two non-blocking notes, your call:
(1) Precision nit in section 4: 'the declaration line is the only occurrence of that identifier in the repository' is slightly wide — retryWithBackoffSync also appears in room metadata notes (.sero/apps/orchestrator/rooms/room_6b8c6290.../room.json:467), not in source. 'only occurrence under src/ / in source files' would be exact. Does not affect any conclusion.
(2) Deliverable on disk: FINDINGS.md does not exist at the project root (read returns ENOENT) — only the artifact exists. If the task requires the file written to the workspace, that write is still outstanding; my mandate bars me from creating it, so it is yours.

Marking my work item done.
